hooks.name: Tests-first guard (agent edit)
hooks.description: Before the agent writes or edits a file, remind it of .kiro/steering/testing.md: feature code only after a failing test for that change exists. Test files, docs and .kiro files pass straight through.

action.prompt: You are about to write to a file. If it is a test file (tests/, *.test.ts, *.test.tsx, *.test.mjs), a doc, or under .kiro/, continue. Otherwise, per .kiro/steering/testing.md, confirm that a test for this exact change already exists and has been seen failing (red). If not, write that test first, run it, and only then make this edit.
